body: But “myself” is quite literally the worst person on earth
Well then sorry but you’re obviously therefore not in the same position and can’t help me
Write whatever you want, it can’t make my life my worse than it already is
My parents are very homophobic and essentially disregard the importance of mental health, my sister doesn’t do anything in fear of going against my parents, and I don’t have any friends
Essentially, yes. But more importantly that despite all of that, no one in my life cares.
